prompts.title: Instagram Flash Restyle
prompts.prompt:
Apply only an Instagram Flash filter-style effect to the uploaded image. Do not regenerate, redesign, crop, reframe, beautify, retouch, or change any content. Preserve the exact same person, face, expression, pose, outfit, hairstyle, objects, background, framing, and composition. Change only the filter treatment: night conversion, direct flash behavior, color grading, visible noise, and film grain.
Convert the image into a darker night-like / low-light version of the same scene. Make the environment cooler, moodier, and richer, with a strong green-cyan / teal ambience and deeper night density, while keeping the original scene recognizable. The background should become darker and cooler than the subject, but not muddy or fully black.
The subject treatment is critical: light the subject with a strong direct on-camera frontal flash that is clearly visible in the result. The flash must dominate the subject more than the ambient light. The face, skin, hair, and clothing facing the camera should look brighter, flatter, more directly flash-lit, and slightly lifted in exposure. The subject should appear more illuminated and more separated from the surroundings, like a real camera-flash snapshot, not a softly relit portrait. Keep the skin warm, bright, glowing, and flash-washed, while the surroundings stay cooler and darker.
If reflective, glossy, metallic, leather, glass, polished, or shiny surfaces are present, show realistic small flash reflections / specular pops where appropriate. If the scene geometry naturally allows it, include a believable subtle hard-edged flash shadow behind the subject or nearby objects, but only where it would occur naturally.
Match the overall look of a rich Instagram Flash-style photo: stronger night mood, cooler green-cyan ambience, brighter flash-lit subject, slightly punchier contrast, and a more obvious filtered look. Add visible digital noise and fine 35mm color-negative film grain across the whole image. Keep the noise and grain clearly visible, especially in darker areas, smooth surfaces, and the background. If the original image already contains noise or compression texture, do not clean it up — blend it naturally into the overall grain structure.
The final result should look like the same original photo captured at night with a strong direct camera flash, featuring richer green-cyan ambience, a much more obviously flash-lit subject, visible film grain, visible noise, and a filtered Instagram Flash look.
Avoid: soft studio lighting, weak flash on the subject, polished portrait lighting, over-clean denoising, overly neutral colors, dull flat skin, muddy blacks, or changing the image content.

prompts.title: The Architect of Will
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, high-end studio portrait of a confident man with an athletic build and neatly styled hair. His expression is calm, neutral, and self-assured, with direct eye contact. Skin must appear natural, no artificial smoothing or overexposure.
Composition & Framing (STRICT)
Full-body shot, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.
Subject positioned slightly left of center, occupying ~45-55% of the frame.
Balanced composition with negative space on the right.
No cropping of head, feet, or limbs. Full body is clearly visible, with natural headroom and a visible floor.
🔒 Ensure the entire wall painting (poster) on the right side is fully visible within the frame with proper margins—no cropping & edge cut-off.
Pose
The subject is casually leaning against the corner of a matte grey wall.
One leg crossed naturally over the other.
Both hands are placed inside the front jean pockets for a stylish look.
Posture relaxed yet confident, shoulders natural, body slightly angled toward the camera.
Outfit & Styling
Burgundy slim-fit polo shirt (pique texture) with a small minimal chest logo
Black relaxed-fit denim jeans with subtle fading
White low-top leather sneakers with clean white soles
Black chronograph watch with rubber strap on left wrist
Clothing must show realistic fabric texture, folds, and natural fit.
Background & Environment
Minimalist studio interior with matte grey walls.
Dark polished wooden floor with subtle reflections.
On the right side: A large, black-framed wall-mounted poster of the same person featuring a high-contrast black-and-white vector-style portrait and bold text reading “NO LIMITS” at the bottom.
Keep background clean, no extra objects.
Focus & Depth of Field (CRITICAL FIX)
Both the subject and the wall painting must be in sharp, equal focus.
Use a deeper depth of field so the poster details and text remain crisp and readable.
❌ No background blur, no bokeh affecting the painting.
Lighting (IMPORTANT)
Cinematic low-key lighting setup.
Single soft directional light from the side creating a soft shadow on the wall.
Face is clearly visible but not overly bright—maintain controlled highlights and gentle shadow falloff.
Subtle contrast with depth, no harsh overexposure.
Color & Mood
Quiet luxury aesthetic with a refined palette: burgundy, matte grey, deep indigo, black, and white.
Clean, modern, editorial look.
Camera & Technical Details
Eye level camera angle
Shot on Sony A7R IV
85mm prime lens, adjusted aperture (around f/4–f/5.6) to maintain full scene focus
ISO 100, shutter speed 1/200
Deep focus clarity across subject and background elements
8K resolution, ultra-detailed, realistic lighting, global illumination, professional color grading
Quality Control (STRICT)
No blur, no distortion, no CGI look
No extra people or elements
No cropping errors
Maintain realistic proportions and natural lighting consistency
